- [doc] SHARC part: ADSP-21569. Section 7 holds ADSP-2156x loader/application records (104 records mapped). FreeRTOS, an Audio task and a recurring block loop are traced. The hand-off from the boot kernel to that startup is not. — `digitakt-2#93b02c8d` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:106](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L106) · Digitakt II / Architecture map from static analysis and simulation (lalzart, OS 1.15C)
- [doc] The ColdFire <-> SHARC frame is the same shape as on the Digitone II: A full-duplex `0xabc`-byte DSPI2 frame carries a `0x802`-byte state payload: 16 records of `0x60` bytes, track n to SHARC unit n. ColdFire eDMA29 sends and eDMA28 receives; the SHARC uses SPI2 with completed-image double buffering. The send is driven from a level-5 interrupt that a level-6 eDMA-completion path forces in software. Link settings: SPI mode 1, 16-bit MSB-first, one `0x55e`-word window. The meaning of the SHARC-to-ColdFire return content is open. Compare the DN2's frame and reply words in [digitone-2-internals.md](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitone-2-internals.md). This is a second, independent reading of the shared design (research map T19). — `digitakt-2#fc3a7acd` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:107](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L107) · Digitakt II / Architecture map from static analysis and simulation (lalzart, OS 1.15C)
- [doc] Project samples reach the SHARC over a different path: ColdFire Rapid-GPIO byte/strobe/ready endpoint -> SHARC link port 0 (LP0_RX, DMA30). Samples are described by five-word resource descriptors with 4 KiB pages. This agrees with digikit finding 15 ([digitakt-2-sharc-measured.md](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2-sharc-measured.md)). The physical bridge between the two endpoints is not identified. — `digitakt-2#6c0de068` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:113](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L113) · Digitakt II / Architecture map from static analysis and simulation (lalzart, OS 1.15C)
- [doc] Audio output: two 64-word banks are selected, then sent by a two-bank circular DMA descriptor (DMA10) to SPORT4 half A. Codec and pin are not identified. — `digitakt-2#3adadccd` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:114](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L114) · Digitakt II / Architecture map from static analysis and simulation (lalzart, OS 1.15C)
- [doc] Update path: MAIN validates checksum, minimum version and the cryptographic trailer before it erases and programs the staged ELE3 slot at flash `0x80000`, then requests a reset. Which updater copy runs after reset, and whether recovery is independent of it, is marked opaque. — `digitakt-2#ac66d559` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:115](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L115) · Digitakt II / Architecture map from static analysis and simulation (lalzart, OS 1.15C)
- [doc] Offline modifications proven in the simulator only: a byte-exact selector reroute, and a 3-byte change that turns an output-bank negation into pass-through. Re-encoding a modified section and running it on hardware are explicitly unproven. — `digitakt-2#5c21977d` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:118](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L118) · Digitakt II / Architecture map from static analysis and simulation (lalzart, OS 1.15C)
- [doc] The main OS's default exception handler prints `EXCEPTION ...` with the vector, format, PC and twelve stack words, then executes `halt` with interrupts masked. It never returns. — `digitakt-2#ead9bf62` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:121](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L121) · Digitakt II / What happens on a ColdFire fault (digikit finding 37, DT2 1.16/1.17 and DN2 1.11/1.12, static, checked by a second agent) `[doc]`
- [doc] The core watchdog is not used anywhere in the main OS, so a fault hangs the whole device until the power is cycled. Messages like the DT2's `V04 M0 P40311A64` (dt2-machine-lab) are this handler's output. — `digitakt-2#e26f286a` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:122](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L122) · Digitakt II / What happens on a ColdFire fault (digikit finding 37, DT2 1.16/1.17 and DN2 1.11/1.12, static, checked by a second agent) `[doc]`
- [doc] digikit's runtime counts bad boots: the counter is raised at boot start and cleared only after 30 s of stable running. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#6bab1b03` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:123](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L123) · Digitakt II / What happens on a ColdFire fault (digikit finding 37, DT2 1.16/1.17 and DN2 1.11/1.12, static, checked by a second agent) `[doc]`
- [doc] The intro is its own task, priority 7, created once by the installer before the main-OS task (DT2 `0x400d1448`, DN2 1.12 `0x400d3920`) and woken by a PIT3 tick. A higher number is more urgent here, so the intro preempts the main-OS task (priority 6). A frame callback that never returns starves the main OS until power-off. — `digitakt-2#50667445` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:129](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L129) · Digitakt II / The stock intro and boot screens (digikit finding 117, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.11/1.12)
- [doc] Five scene tables at `0x402a1b64`, `0x402a1b74`, `0x402a1b84`, `0x402a1b94`, `0x402a1ba4`. Each boot picks one with an LCG; the first is picked about 99.9 % of the time and has 175 frames. An entry is `{callback, frame count}`, ended by a 0. — `digitakt-2#213e1636` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:130](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L130) · Digitakt II / The stock intro and boot screens (digikit finding 117, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.11/1.12)
- [doc] One pointer drives it: the current entry is at DT2 `0x43153a00`, DN2 1.12 `0x42c4cacc`, DN2 1.11 `0x42c4bacc`. Only the setup function (DT2 `0x400d1832`, DN2 1.12 `0x400d3d0a`) and the tick function (DT2 `0x400d18f0`, DN2 1.12 `0x400d3dc8`) touch it. Each frame calls `callback(index, count, bitmap)`; count 0 ends the intro the normal way: the pointer is cleared, PIT3 stops and semaphore `0x43149550` releases the main-OS task. — `digitakt-2#03511f29` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:131](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L131) · Digitakt II / The stock intro and boot screens (digikit finding 117, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.11/1.12)
- [doc] Frame rate unresolved: digikit's timer model gives 30 Hz (175 frames = 5.8 s); its earlier emulator notes derived 15 Hz. Open conflict [O20](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/CONFLICTS.md). Module code first runs at about frame 53-57 of the intro (emulator); almost all of that delay is stock setup. — `digitakt-2#94406db6` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:133](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L133) · Digitakt II / The stock intro and boot screens (digikit finding 117, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.11/1.12)
- [doc] Faults during the intro reach stock's halting handler (see the section above): digikit installs its own crash handler only from the UI loop. — `digitakt-2#550f9d5c` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:134](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L134) · Digitakt II / The stock intro and boot screens (digikit finding 117, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.11/1.12)
- [doc] digikit's patchkit (used by digitakt-ii-research's All-in-One and dt2-machine-lab), elekloader's core-dt2 (used by digitakt2-perform) and the hand-placed builds share the flash cave `0x403117c4-0x40312000`. elekloader's RAM `0x47f00000-0x47f40000` lies inside digikit's `cf.expansion` `0x47e8b000-0x47fe0000`. Full table of ranges and hook sites: [memory-maps.md](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/common/memory-maps.md). `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#c6300eb6` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:159](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L159) · Digitakt II / Three Digitakt II mod routes side by side (T21, 2026-11-02)
- [doc] Reading a track's Sound parameter words needs no fixed address: get the project singleton, its ProjectSettings at project + `0x30` (static analysis only), the selected track from `view_track` (clamped 0-15), then `native_track_sound(active kit, track)` = kit + `0x6c` + `0x3c0` x track; vtable slot `0x28` of that Sound object returns the record pointer `*(sound + 0x10)` (0 when none is bound), and word i is a big-endian s16 at record + `0x14` + 2i. Anchors: settings `0x40041d18` (DT2 1.17) / `0x4003e40e` (DN2 1.12); `native_track_sound` `0x40035cca` / `0x40030e66`. The array holds 71 words on the DT2 and 101 on the DN2. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#2f9dd954` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:167](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L167) · Digitakt II / Sound parameters, overdrive and run-time machines (digikit, DT2 1.17 / DN2 1.12, 2026-11-10)
- [doc] Track overdrive (stock): the curve clamps to +-1 and applies y*(2-|y|) three times; the blend is x + mix*(y-x) with stock ramps for drive and mix. OVR Routing is parameter `0x103` (Sound mirror index 68; 0 = pre, `0x100` = post). The per-track stage is called twice per track from the voice chain. `[doc]` {digikit-overdrive} — `digitakt-2#b6a530b4` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:169](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L169) · Digitakt II / Sound parameters, overdrive and run-time machines (digikit, DT2 1.17 / DN2 1.12, 2026-11-10)
- [doc] Run-time machines: on the DT2 they can use knob slots B C E F G H; a parameter on the seventh slot replaces LEV, whose level is then fixed at 100. The run-time module stage is limited to 64 KB; a TB-303 port costs about 8,000 SHARC instructions per 32-sample block. `[doc]` {digikit-tb303} — `digitakt-2#7e9747d1` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:170](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L170) · Digitakt II / Sound parameters, overdrive and run-time machines (digikit, DT2 1.17 / DN2 1.12, 2026-11-10)
- [doc] The firmware's own file calls can write samples: open (`0x40158902`, mode "w"), write (`0x4015866a`), reserve, hash (`0x4015b3aa`), close (`0x401588c0`), info, delete (`0x40157078`), mkdir and rename (`0x40156f6c`, which keeps the inode, size and stored hash). Each takes the recursive filesystem mutex itself and blocks, so call them from a task, never an interrupt. The sampler's recorder `0x40153c70` is a complete stock caller. `[doc]` (static) — `digitakt-2#236ea41c` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:175](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L175) · Digitakt II / +Drive file writes from mod code (digikit finding 120, DT2 1.17)
- [doc] Open does not truncate: an existing file opens at position 0 with its old size and data; stock deletes first. Whole 32 KiB pages at multiples of `0x8000` are written straight from the buffer, the rest goes through the page cache. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#1e9e4d84` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:176](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L176) · Digitakt II / +Drive file writes from mod code (digikit finding 120, DT2 1.17)
- [doc] Power cut: a cut mid-write leaves a visible file with a partial size and no hash; the mount was not seen to repair it. Delete refuses an open file (open-file bitmap at `0x46f4ded0`). Only `/factory` is RAM-backed; user files always go to the card, and a failed card write is not reported. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#3eabeb87` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:178](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L178) · Digitakt II / +Drive file writes from mod code (digikit finding 120, DT2 1.17)
- [doc] In RAM: the project object is at `0x41776c9c`; 128 patterns from `0x41776cb8` (stride `0x1db8c`), 128 kits from `0x426532b8` (stride `0x5574`). Serializer `0x400df66c` (flag bits pick the parts), loader `0x400df95a`. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#139eedc4` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:182](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L182) · Digitakt II / Project and kit storage (digikit finding 121, DT2 1.17)
- [doc] Sample rows are shared: digikit's `core/sample-pool` reserves the top sixteen rows (H112-H127); Sketch uses H124-H127 for live buffers and H116-H123 for FREEZE, so the two declare a conflict. A user sample in those rows also blocks the reservation. Two mods that reserve sample rows need one owner. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#30a451e6` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:188](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L188) · Digitakt II / Projects, sample rows and the recorder (dt2-machine-lab Sketch, OS 1.16 and 1.17, 2026-11-13)
- [doc] OS 1.16 recorder editor (static): the waveform service `0x4001266a` issues recorder command 3 for four signed extrema; encoder handling at `0x40020960`; trim endpoints at view +`0x9a0`/+`0x9a4`; the accepted-range copy is command 4 at `0x4001282e`. The native accept refuses ranges below 141 frames. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#94d392eb` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:189](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L189) · Digitakt II / Projects, sample rows and the recorder (dt2-machine-lab Sketch, OS 1.16 and 1.17, 2026-11-13)
- [doc] Sites: encoder filter `0x40111cda`; per-frame value block `0x80005b50`; modulator call site `0x4002e90c`; LED frame `0x4003117c`, LED setter `0x400308e0`; NameView wrapper `0x40117c70`. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#b7490ff8` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:194](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L194) · Digitakt II / UI surfaces for mods (digikit finding 122, DT2 1.17)
- [doc] USB mode switch: `FUN_40006c16` has the same address and bytes on DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12. It takes no lock and cuts a MIDI reply in flight; USB restarts after a 30-tick counter (about 1 s in the emulator; counter DT2 `0x40965a38`, DN2 `0x4058f280`). The stored USB CONFIG byte (0 MIDI, 1 Overbridge, 2 AUDIO/MIDI; DT2 `0x4099d5c4`, DN2 `0x405ce898`) is written only by the menu actions (DT2 `0x4010331a`/`30`/`48`, DN2 `0x40104dc2`/`d8`/`f0`), never by the switch, so a reboot returns to the stored mode; an Overbridge disconnect (`FUN_400f2ce0`) is the only path that re-applies it by itself. DT2 connection-state word `0x40965a40`. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#bf9d1341` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:198](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L198) · Digitakt II / USB mode take-over and fast close (digikit findings 123-125, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12)
- [doc] +Drive internals: close hash `0x4015b1e8` under the filesystem mutex `0x46f4deb0` (recursive lock `0x400015a0`, unlock `0x400016d2`); inode get/put/write `0x4015b92a`/`0x4015b846`/`0x4015b868`; extent lookup `0x4015813c`; hash-table rebuild `0x4015b0ee` (about 300 ms per file on a unit); event post `0x4015a6aa`. Data page 0 is card sector `0x5ee180` (page p at base + p x `0x40`), the first hash page sector `0x5ee980`. Every file write reaches the card before the call returns. The eSDHC read/write is clamped to 64 KiB (DT2 `0x4012e3c4`, DN2 `0x4012ca8a`). `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#62df9041` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:200](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L200) · Digitakt II / USB mode take-over and fast close (digikit findings 123-125, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12)
- [doc] SHARC cycle counter: each image has exactly one EMUCLK reader, the block handler (DT2 `0x1c74cd`, DN2 `0x1c9d6b`), which keeps a low-word delta for reporting only; nothing branches on it. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#efc4e61f` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:203](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L203) · Digitakt II / USB mode take-over and fast close (digikit findings 123-125, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12)
- [doc] eMMC EXT_CSD copy in RAM: DT2 1.17 `0x4fe69100`, DN2 1.12 `0x4e6f9100`; bytes are reversed within each 32-bit word because the eSDHC runs little-endian. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#507f758b` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:204](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L204) · Digitakt II / USB mode take-over and fast close (digikit findings 123-125, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12)
- [doc] External ULPI PHY: the USB controller drives an external ULPI PHY (PORTSC.PTS = ULPI, set at init `0x40006d1c`-`0x40006d2c`). The stock firmware writes no PHY register: its only ULPI_VIEWPORT (`0xFC0B0170`) use is a read of PHY register 0 every 300 calls of a periodic function (`0x40006af8`), which resets the controller (not the PHY) when the read never finishes. It never sets PORTSC.PHCD. The VBUS interrupt (`0x40005e14`, OTGSC.BSVIS) starts or stops the controller; the restart `0x40006bc6` starts it only while OTGSC.BSV is set. Same code on DN2 1.12. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#df260dc9` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:208](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L208) · Digitakt II / USB take-over failures and card speed (digikit, 2026-11-13)
- [doc] The USB clock comes from the PHY: the stock init clears MISCCR.USBSRC (`0xEC09000E` bit 0), so the PHY's 60 MHz ULPI output clocks the controller's USB side. A PHY whose clock stops freezes USB while the rest of the unit runs on. The documented way to restart a stopped PHY clock is a viewport wake-up (WU set, RUN clear). Same code on DN2 1.12. `[doc]` {digikit-f123-bulk} — `digitakt-2#6cb961b6` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:209](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L209) · Digitakt II / USB take-over failures and card speed (digikit, 2026-11-13)
- [doc] Stock controller reset: `0x40006ada` (same on DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12) stops the controller with restart type 2; after 30 ticks `0x40007104` sets USBCMD.RST and spins on it with no bound, runs the USB init `0x40006c52` and restarts if VBUS is valid. The firmware's own viewport watchdog uses this path. Each reset leaks one of the 16 shared timer slots (SB20). `[doc]` {digikit-f123-bulk} — `digitakt-2#7da8ae6b` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:210](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L210) · Digitakt II / USB take-over failures and card speed (digikit, 2026-11-13)
- [doc] USB AUDIO/MIDI port entry 5: the port table has 0x28-byte entries; entry 5 is at table + 0xC8 (DT2 `0x4029f048`): +0 connect `0x400040a6`, +4 disconnect `0x40004054`, +0xC configuration pointer, +0x10 length 0x148. The configuration has 5 interfaces (UAC2 on 0-2, MIDI on 3-4 with the EP1 bulk pair); EP2 IN is the iso feedback and EP2 OUT is unused. A bus reset clears ENDPTCTRL1-3 and every queue head, and SET_CONFIGURATION calls connect again. DN2 1.12 has the same code at other data addresses. `[doc]` {digikit-f123-bulk} — `digitakt-2#b5b78a17` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:212](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L212) · Digitakt II / USB take-over failures and card speed (digikit, 2026-11-13)
- [doc] Stock card driver: data moves by eDMA channel 59 to the eSDHC data port, 16 bytes per request; every write uses CMD23 with the reliable-write bit. The block write and read split every transfer into 64 KiB commands: `cmpi.l #0x10000,D2` at offset 0x14 (entry) and 0x22 (chunk loop) of each function, same bytes on both images: DT2 1.17 read `0x4012e1b6` (sites `0x4012e1ca`, `0x4012e1d8`), write `0x4012e39c` (sites `0x4012e3b0`, `0x4012e3be`); DN2 1.12 read `0x4012c87a` (`0x4012c88e`, `0x4012c89c`), write `0x4012ca60` (`0x4012ca74`, `0x4012ca82`). The 64 KiB bounce buffer for unaligned buffers is the likely reason; the eDMA's 15-bit count allows at most 1023 blocks (511 KiB) a command, which digikit's sdhc-large uses (1022) for 16-byte aligned buffers it registers. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#7dd73593` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:215](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L215) · Digitakt II / USB take-over failures and card speed (digikit, 2026-11-13)
- [doc] +Drive ids at or above `0x1000000` never reach the card (DT2 1.17): the inode write-back `0x4015b868` and page write-back `0x40155c34` call the block write only for inode ids and page numbers below `0x1000000`; higher ones are copied into RAM tables (inodes at `0x47d73ed0 + n*0x80`, pages at `0x46f63ed0 + n*0x8000`, n counted from `0x1000000`). `[doc]` {digikit-f120} — `digitakt-2#c199ed2e` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:218](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L218) · Digitakt II / USB take-over failures and card speed (digikit, 2026-11-13)
- [doc] NRPN numbers disagree between the OS 1.17 manual and midi.guide's data for track mute and level, pattern mute, master overdrive, filter env depth, filter base/width and portamento; all CCs agree (CONFLICTS O24). `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#ef50832e` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:221](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L221) · Digitakt II / MIDI notes from whiplash (DT2, OS 1.17 manual, 2026-11)
- [doc] CC 80 (amp HOLD) at 127 switches HOLD to NOTE; it is not the longest hold. A sound ends on note-off only with AMP MODE = ADSR or HOLD = NOTE. Note 60 plays a sample at its own pitch only with TUNE 64 and the preset OCTAVE unchanged. No CC or NRPN selects the machine type. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#51e4fad0` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:222](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L222) · Digitakt II / MIDI notes from whiplash (DT2, OS 1.17 manual, 2026-11)
- [doc] USB audio: class-compliant audio exists only in USB AUDIO/MIDI mode, with one stereo USB OUT pair; track outputs over USB carry no effects; INT TO MAIN = AUTO mutes the internal outs while USB audio streams. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#4be1d7f4` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:224](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L224) · Digitakt II / MIDI notes from whiplash (DT2, OS 1.17 manual, 2026-11)
- [doc] The function at `0x4000434a` stores two USB MIDI callbacks into .bss slots: `0x409659d0` / `0x409659d4` on the Digitakt II (1.17), `0x4058f218` / `0x4058f21c` on the Digitone II 1.12. USB MIDI that arrives before they are set leaves the link dead while the CPU runs (an emulator-only failure in digikit's tests). `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#cc76f8eb` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:236](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L236) · Digitakt II / USB MIDI callbacks and Shot's cost (digikit handover, 2026-11-15)
- [doc] One card transfer at a time: the eSDHC has one command and one data channel, no command queue and no packed commands; it supports SD Host 2.0 and MMC 4.2 only (no DDR), and the 8-bit pins are not bonded. The reference manual gives 40 MHz as the eSDHC maximum; the firmware runs 37.7 MHz (SDCLKFS=1, DVS=0, DT2 setup `0x4012d78e`). A command without data (CMD13) can go out during a data transfer, but errata SECF214 says it may see a spurious CRC or index error. FIFO 128 x 32 bit; the controller stops the card clock on FIFO under- or overrun. Wire ceiling about 18.5 MB/s payload, about 9.3 MB/s for write plus full read-back. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#d41cd0a1` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:245](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L245) · Digitakt II / Card concurrency, upload phases and hot-reload facts (digikit findings 133-135, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12, 2026-11-16/17)
- [doc] Stock card driver locking: every block transfer runs under one global mutex (DT2 `0x47de3cac`) plus a second mutex `0x44e4ae98` taken through `0x401344dc`; a request above 64 KiB is cut into 64 KiB chunks, each locked on its own. The caller starts eDMA channel 59 and waits with `sem_pend` on `0x44e3fec8` (command complete) and `0x44e3fec0` / `0x44e3feb8` (data); the eSDHC ISR `0x4012d5ba` (vector 223) posts `0x44e3fec8` on CC/CTOE and `0x44e3fec0` on TC or a data error (the poster of `0x44e3feb8` was not found). The task sleeps during DMA and card busy, so other tasks get the CPU. Reads use CMD18 with auto-CMD12 and no CMD23; writes send CMD23 with the reliable-write bit before every CMD25, no auto-CMD12. Setup: CMD6 HS_TIMING=1, BUS_WIDTH=1 (4 bit), ERASE_GROUP_DEF=1, CMD16 512; no cache enable or flush, packed commands or command queue seen. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#f419b52f` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:246](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L246) · Digitakt II / Card concurrency, upload phases and hot-reload facts (digikit findings 133-135, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12, 2026-11-16/17)
- [?] [doc] RTOS primitives (DT2 1.17; the DN2 1.12 mutex functions sit at the same addresses): priority-preemptive, a larger number is a higher priority; task switch by `trap #0` (`0x40000410`); no tick that rotates tasks of equal priority was found `[?]`. Binary semaphores `sem_init` `0x40001398`, `sem_pend` `0x4000141a`, `sem_post` `0x4000155c` (a counting variant at `0x4000148c`, `0x400014fc`, `0x4000172a`). Mutexes `0x400015a0` / `0x400016d2` are recursive for the owner with FIFO waiters and no priority inheritance. No task delete, yield or event flags were found. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#cd3c520e` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:247](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L247) · Digitakt II / Card concurrency, upload phases and hot-reload facts (digikit findings 133-135, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12, 2026-11-16/17)
- [doc] +Drive serialises as well: every `file.*` and `path.*` call runs under the file-system mutex `0x46f4deb0`, and the close (`0x4015b3aa` -> `0x4015b1e8`) holds it through the whole read-back and hash-table work. Several files can be open (open bitmap `0x46f4ded0`), but they share static scratch buffers (`0x4066d8c0`, `0x406658c0`, `0x44f2bc68`). So several writers (tasks, files or pieces of one file) cannot raise card throughput; a pipeline (one task waits on the card while another copies or hashes in RAM) is safe and helps. Keep middle-priority work from delaying the task that holds the card mutex. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#be9eb336` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:248](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L248) · Digitakt II / Card concurrency, upload phases and hot-reload facts (digikit findings 133-135, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12, 2026-11-16/17)
- [doc] +Drive page allocation (DT2 1.17): `file_reserve` `0x40158810` calls `0x40158448(id, 0, bytes, 0)`: inode get, missing-page count `0x40158326`, free-page count `0x40155f84` (bit by bit over the 0x14010-byte bitmap, no I/O), then `0x401581dc(inode, 0, pages, 0)` and the inode write-back `0x4015b868`. `0x401581dc` allocates first fit with `0x40155974` from page `0xa7a`, then from 0, writes the touched bitmap pages and adds one extent per allocation (`0x40157c68`); it stops silently when no page is free and does not write the inode back. Call it under the file-system mutex with an inode from inode get, hint 0. `[doc]` {digikit-f120} — `digitakt-2#0d53feef` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:249](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L249) · Digitakt II / Card concurrency, upload phases and hot-reload facts (digikit findings 133-135, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12, 2026-11-16/17)
- [doc] CACR and the by-address flush: both images write CACR once, at `0x4000055a` (`move.l #0xa50ce100,d0`: SPA=1, IVO=0, DDPI=0, IDPI=0, instruction and data cache on). With SPA=1, `cpushl bc,(ax)` searches by physical address and clears the line in both caches (RM Table 6-10), so one `cpushl` per 16-byte line is a correct flush for new code. Do not write CACR yourself. Whether a pipeline sync is needed after the last `cpushl` is open. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#29dcc5eb` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:253](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L253) · Digitakt II / Card concurrency, upload phases and hot-reload facts (digikit findings 133-135, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12, 2026-11-16/17)
- [doc] The UI task and its queue: DT2 `main_os_task` `0x400337ba` (created at `0x40033280`, TCB `0x40966ee8`, priority 6, stack `0x4096775c` + `0x28000`) waits on queue `0x40966f3c` (wait function `0x40001928`) and switches on the message byte; the UI-loop site is `0x40033d06`. DN2: entry `0x4002ed34`, created at `0x4002e902`, TCB `0x4059e1c0`, queue `0x4059e214`, site `0x4002f17e`. No other code reads that queue, so modal pop-ups and browsers run inside message handlers and a UI-loop hook runs once per message. A7 inside one of the two stacks tells which task runs a hook. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#4f9c5f35` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:255](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L255) · Digitakt II / Card concurrency, upload phases and hot-reload facts (digikit findings 133-135, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12, 2026-11-16/17)
- [doc] Two level-7 interrupts (not maskable): INTC0 ICR2 (`0xfc048042`, set at `0x40001cbe`): EPF2, vector 0x108, handler `0x40001a10`, a 516-byte leaf with no callees. INTC1 ICR40 (`0xfc04c068`, set at `0x400d346e`): EDMA_INTR, its handler installed at run time into vector 0x2a0 from pointer `0x43153a2c` (DN2 sites `0x400d56c6`, `0x400d5996`); which code it runs is open. An IPL-7 mask therefore does not keep these two out. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#3703a791` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:256](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L256) · Digitakt II / Card concurrency, upload phases and hot-reload facts (digikit findings 133-135, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12, 2026-11-16/17)
- [doc] Empty machine rows and the name table: stock `mf_dispatch` `0x400c89a4` uses `type < 7 ? 0x4293b960 + 0x2c * type : 0x4293ba68`, and the compare is unsigned (so -1 is out of range too); the fallback `0x4293ba68` is the row of type 6, the last stock machine, not type 0 (finding 135 as rewritten 2026-11-18 {digikit-1119}; the earlier reading "plays as type 0" is wrong, S24). No code keeps a pointer to a name-table row (only `lea` in the accessors); the machine list is fetched once into the view at boot. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#9c3d4e17` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:257](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L257) · Digitakt II / Card concurrency, upload phases and hot-reload facts (digikit findings 133-135, DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12, 2026-11-16/17)
- [doc] The six `type == 6` (MANUAL SLICE) tests on DT2 1.17, for anyone who clones MANUAL SLICE: `0x4005fbec` (`moveq #6,D1; cmp.l D0,D1; beq.w`, target `0x4005fcd4`), `0x4005f8f8` (`bne.b`, target `0x4005f920`), `0x40030e1e` (`bne.w`, target `0x40030f90`), `0x4004923e` (D6 holds 6, target `0x40049266`), `0x4005c936` (type in D2, target `0x4005c950`) and in the frame builder `0x4002ec18` (`mvs.b (0x990,A0),D0`, target `0x4002ecd8`). digikit removed its hooks there on 2026-11-18 because no machine of theirs clones MANUAL SLICE. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#d5eaf940` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:262](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L262) · Digitakt II / digikit findings: MANUAL SLICE tests, menu font, DSP slot stubs (DT2 1.17, 2026-11-18)
- [doc] The masked test `(type & ~2) == 4` is at `0x4005da60` (12 bytes; first four instructions); its `beq.w` target is `0x4005db02`. digikit maps an added type to its `clone_of` there. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#be2231be` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:263](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L263) · Digitakt II / digikit findings: MANUAL SLICE tests, menu font, DSP slot stubs (DT2 1.17, 2026-11-18)

- [doc] The VerticalMenuView font is not at a fixed field offset: the field offset differs between firmwares, so read the font from the `move.l #font,D0` literal in the constructor (6 bytes at constructor + `0xb6`): DT2 1.17 `0x4011a022`, DN2 1.12 `0x4011b996`. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#ebb86d53` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:265](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L265) · Digitakt II / digikit findings: MANUAL SLICE tests, menu font, DSP slot stubs (DT2 1.17, 2026-11-18)
- [doc] ColdFire pointer-slot stubs (pattern): 12 bytes per site (`movea.l slot,aN; tst.l aN; beq.b; jmp (aN)`, or `move.l slot,dN; beq.b; move.l dN,-(sp); rts`); the installer writes the slot word under IPL 7 and then flushes the cache line. A displaced instruction with a `(d8,PC,Xn)` operand cannot be re-encoded and needs a hand-written tail. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#d2468d71` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:267](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L267) · Digitakt II / digikit findings: MANUAL SLICE tests, menu font, DSP slot stubs (DT2 1.17, 2026-11-18)
- [doc] USB MIDI in every USB mode: OS 1.17 offers USB MIDI in MIDI, Audio/MIDI and Overbridge modes, so a SysEx link over it needs no change to the USB descriptors. Modwerk reports that the stock transmit path can wait indefinitely for buffer space, so a link reply must not block when the host stops reading. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#d92c76a3` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:270](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L270) · Digitakt II / Modwerk's Digitakt II plan (GOAL.md, OS 1.17, 2026-11-16)

- [doc] Core 1.1 storage sites (stock bytes guarded): kit save `0x400dbee4`, kit load `0x400db8be`, project save `0x400df932`, project load `0x400df99c`, `memcpy` `0x40136388`, key-LED frame call `0x400311a2`. Modwerk base: 22 sites, 10,032 B `.run` + 9,848 B `.bss` (19,880 B) in the shared DDR. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#e703a1ba` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:277](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L277) · Digitakt II / Modwerk base 8650bb8a, Euclidean Scale and Mute Latch (OS 1.17, 2026-11-08..17)
- [doc] Play state is two words: u32 at `0x43164f94` and `0x43165010`, each 0 stopped, 1 playing, 2 paused; the firmware's own test ORs the two (`0x400d688a`). Live record = playing and the byte at UIStates + `0x271`. `[doc]` (checked against the image bytes by a second reader) — `digitakt-2#58eb181b` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:284](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L284) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 147-149: play state, filter type, LFO paths (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-18)
- [doc] Filter type is a byte at sound + `0xa3`, right after the machine type byte. The accessor `0x400c89c6` takes types up to 5 and otherwise a fallback row; the stock sound loader resets a type of 6 or more to 0 (bound at `0x400db484`); the setter and the chooser apply no bound. Over MIDI the filter setter sends parameter `0xea`, which is parameter row 6 "Machine Type", the same id the machine setter sends (finding 150; corrected 2026-11-20, see O39); what a receiving unit does with it is open (H54). Names (table `0x4020ef30`): MM, LP4, EQU, COMB-, LEG, COMB+. On the DSP side the per-track type maps through DM `0x2567a0` (types 0-5 give 1, 3, 2, 4, 5, 6), read once in the emulator. On the DT2 the filter rows and the machine rows are one contiguous array. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#bd87d4d3` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:285](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L285) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 147-149: play state, filter type, LFO paths (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-18)
- [doc] LFO paths: tick `0x4013961e`, function table `0x402227d4`, and a second reader of that table at `0x401392d4`: a new waveform has to patch both. A third compare with 6 sets the RAND start phase; a wave byte of `0x80` or more is clamped to 0 and plays as TRI; the sound and p-lock loaders do not clamp the wave value. The LFO state belongs to a voice slot, not a track; the final LFO output is in the DSP transmit frame at `0x80005348` + `0xda` + stride x slot, so the live row alone is not enough. Graph tiles are 28 x 15 pixels. The claim that wave 7 "jumps into data" is wrong (digikit); the 1.16 facts above (the table cannot be extended by appending) stand. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#8a69e99a` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:286](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L286) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 147-149: play state, filter type, LFO paths (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-18)
- [doc] Parameter table rows: MIDI CC and NRPN are halfwords at +`0x18`, the slot at +`0x1c`, template words at +`0x20`/+`0x24`, name +`0x28`, short name +`0x30`, formatter +`0x34`; range accessor `0x400da368`. `[doc]` (same layout on the DN2, see O37) — `digitakt-2#14bac7bc` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:287](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L287) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 147-149: play state, filter type, LFO paths (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-18)
- [doc] Brain and the boot check: Brain pointer global `0x44f37098`; its view manager at Brain + `0x40` is a list of views. The boot "FILE SYSTEM OK" confirm window runs when the card superblock (eMMC sector `0x5D8000`) has state 3 or its checked word is 0; digikit's own card builders wrote 0, so every card they built ran the check at first boot (fixed). `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#f85d16d8` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:288](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L288) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 147-149: play state, filter type, LFO paths (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-18)
- [doc] Flash flow risk: after the last SysEx block a host can report "done" while the unit is still writing flash, and the old image can still answer INFO (digikit plan; not fixed yet). Wait for the unit's own restart before you call a flash finished (A23). `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#8ef667ce` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:290](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L290) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 147-149: play state, filter type, LFO paths (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-18)
- [doc] Project hook sites: slot setter `0x400c11ca` (first bytes `73 39` = `mvs.b (abs).l,D1`, 6 bytes to displace, slot argument at SP+4; callers `0x400424a2` and `0x400c0d90`); save `0x40043a30` (`(Project*, slot, progress)`, prologue `4f ef ff cc 48 d7 7c 1c`, 8 bytes); save exit `0x40043b1e` (save + `0xee`, the only `rts`; D0.b nonzero on success, slot in D3; a `before` hook must keep D2-D4/A2-A6). `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#25041a32` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:294](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L294) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 110, 148 and 150: project paths, SHARC filter dispatch, machine setter (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-20)
- [doc] Slot `0x80` is the live mirror: the save wrapper `0x40043b78` sets the slot, saves the real slot through `0x40043b28` (rejects slots above `0x80`), then saves the mirror slot `0x80`, then sets the slot again. New project (`initializeNewProject` `0x400465e2`) saves only the mirror; the wrapper saves the real slot. A save-exit hook sees D3 = `0x80` on the mirror save and must skip it. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#5ffedc68` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:295](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L295) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 110, 148 and 150: project paths, SHARC filter dispatch, machine setter (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-20)
- [doc] Card write result: `0x400f5150` returns 0 for a slot above `0x80`, else the record flush `0x400f4d8c`: D0.b = 1 when written, 0 on failure, for a null record, or when the record is not loaded or not dirty (only the low byte is defined). `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#e82a1bb9` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:296](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L296) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 110, 148 and 150: project paths, SHARC filter dispatch, machine setter (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-20)
- [doc] Project name: at most 16 bytes; the name entry's character table `0x4025dea9` holds `A-Z`, `Å Ä Ö Ü ß Æ Ø Ç Ñ` (bytes `c5 c4 d6 dc df c6 d8 c7 d1`), `0-9`, `~!@#$%^&()_+-=`, space; no lower case. The live name stores bytes of `0x80` and up as 0; the slot listing record (`MmcFs + 0x10 + slot * 0x1c`, name +8, save stamp +`0x18`) keeps them. Rename (callback `0x400a1246`) writes the name into the slot record, card-writes it and, for the current slot, calls `ProjectDataChangeInfo` `0x40042140`; it does not check other slots' names. Whether a rename keeps the save stamp is open. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#e410742c` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:297](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L297) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 110, 148 and 150: project paths, SHARC filter dispatch, machine setter (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-20)
- [doc] What each stock project path does (slot setter S, save stamp at slot record +`0x18`): Delete (callback `0x400a13f0`) clears the record's valid byte (`0x400f4d58`) and erases the card slot, S(-1) only if the deleted slot is current, no save. Clear (`0x400a131e` single, `0x400a1376` several slots) resets the record through `0x4004234e` (name "NEW PROJECT", bulk regions from +`0x200`) but keeps the save stamp. Paste (`0x400a12f8` -> `0x400f548e`) copies `0xdd9604` bytes from the clipboard to the destination record from its start, stamp and name included. Unload calls `initializeNewProject(-1)`. Format (`0x40131276`) calls S(-1) only when a Project exists; its first erase loop covers `0x400000` bytes in `0x800` chunks (whether every later loop stays below digikit's store at `0x457FFF` is open). Load from card: wrapper `0x40046c38`, `loadProjectFromMmc` `0x40046906`, S at `0x40046ca0`, then a mirror save. `0x40041c96` is a change notification, not the stamp builder (corrects digikit's earlier plan). `[doc]` (DT2 traced; Move (cut) `0x400f539e` has no static callers; what triggers load from memory `0x40043f74` is open) — `digitakt-2#6497e267` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:298](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L298) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 110, 148 and 150: project paths, SHARC filter dispatch, machine setter (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-20)
- [doc] Filter type graph: the response graph is x 21..71, y 7..23 (51 x 17 px); a type outside 0..5 draws no response curve and leaves that box blank, while the filter envelope graph (x 21..71, y 34..50) and the page dots still draw. `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#ad18e064` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:299](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L299) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 110, 148 and 150: project paths, SHARC filter dispatch, machine setter (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-20)
- [doc] SHARC filter dispatch: the converter `0x1c24e9` maps the track's filter-type frame word through DM `0x2567a0` to S3 and stores it at word +31 of the per-voice record (base `0x2506ec` + voice x `0xdc`; the machine selector goes to +16). `0x1c642a` then jumps on S3 twice, both bounded at 7: a coefficient stage (table `0x8055c858`, bound at `0x1c66be`, skip at `0x1c66d8`) and a process stage (table `0x8055c874`, bound `0x1c6c0d`, skip `0x1c6c13`). Process routines: S3 1 `0x1cdbb2`, 2 `0x1cd286`, 3 `0x1cc79e`, 4 and 6 `0x1cbf07`, 5 `0x1ccd96`; all but 5 run in place on the voice buffer, 5 writes to `0x8045c3c0`. Static cost per 32-sample block (upper bound, no stalls): about 640, 1,140, 2,300, 1,635 and 490 instructions. `[doc]` The `0x2567a0` table is filled at run time (not in the image). `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#e6d0dabf` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:300](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L300) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 110, 148 and 150: project paths, SHARC filter dispatch, machine setter (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-20)

- [doc] Machine type setter `0x40051712` `(track object*, type, track, flag)`: refuses a type the track does not permit (`0x400da514`), writes sound + `0xa2` only when a settings mode (`0x4004c6f8`) is not 2, posts a SoundParamChangedInfo, and with flag set sends parameter `0xea` (type << 7, `0x40121c74`) or (`0xf`, type) (`0x40121c2c`) depending on another setting. The chooser calls the KitActive wrapper `0x40036798` `(KitActive, track, type, 1, 1)`, which for type 5 (probably the MIDI machine) sets bit `track` in the mask at KitActive + `0x552e` and addresses track objects at KitActive + `0x6c` + track x `0x3c0`. The filter setter `0x40051886` is a copy without the permit check and sends the same parameter `0xea`. Never write the type byte directly: a raw write to sound + `0xa3` did not reach the DSP (finding 148). How code outside a view gets KitActive was open (answered in the digikit-1121 section below); the Project singleton comes from `0x40198b7e` (global `0x44f370a0`). `[doc]` — `digitakt-2#76486466` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:302](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L302) · Digitakt II / digikit findings 110, 148 and 150: project paths, SHARC filter dispatch, machine setter (DT2 1.17, static, 2026-11-20)

- [doc] Key LEDs: the LED frame (`0x4003117c`) clears every LED, then the views set theirs and the first setter wins. A handler sets an LED through the stock setter with layer 2 (value's high nibble a colour; layer 1 turns it off); trig keys are key code + 1, the page keys TRIG to MOD key code + 19. - [doc] Kit copies: a kit is `0x5574` bytes and the OS copies kits in RAM with `memcpy` (`0x40136388`): pattern copy and paste, PASTE KIT, undo, the clipboard. - [doc] Key event path: the UI task pops a key record (caller `0x40033d94`) and calls the runner `0x40030bd0` `(Brain*, KeyEvent*)`, which calls an idle reset (`0x40030b50`), the listeners at Brain + `0x94`, then tail-jumps to the walker `0x4011c79c` `(ViewController*, KeyEvent*)`. The walker runs the release callbacks of the key on a release, then offers the event to the views from the top (offer loop `0x4011c41a`, vtable slot 2); the first nonzero answer stops it. Every view sees keys only through it. KeyEvent: +`0xc` key code, +`0x10` flags (bit 0 press, bit 1 FUNC held, bit 4 release). - [doc] A clean hook site for key events: the walker entry, 8 bytes `4fef ffa0 48d7 7cfc` (`lea -0x60(sp),sp; movem.l`), same bytes on DN2. Consume with `moveq #1,d0; rts`: views and release callbacks are skipped, the runner's listeners still ran. D0, D1, A0, A1 are live at the tail, so save them. Swallow the release of a swallowed press and pass the release of a passed one; never swallow TRK. - [doc] Planned split (approved, not built): a flashed resident core (about 108 KB: reset installer, platform hooks, boot counter, safe mode, crash and hang records, DSP hang watch, store, the Transfer repair commands, a 2-3 KB stage-1 loader) and a card system package (about 167 KB: package manager, full loader, DSP loading, DIGIKIT menu). Stage 1 streams the package through the 128 KB stage with a SHA-256 check and puts it at the top of the 512 KB arena. A missing, broken or wrong-version package gives a new core-only level (stock firmware plus Transfer, no DIGIKIT UI), not counted as a crash. `[doc]` {digikit-1123} — `digitakt-2#61727f23` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:340](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L340) · Digitakt II / digikit runtime plans and LFO hooks at load (DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12, emulator and plans, 2026-11-22/23)

- [doc] The DIGIKIT menu and the runtime lifecycle left the flashed image for a card file `digikit/system.dksp` (192,856 B), loaded into its own 320 KiB block beside the 512 KiB module arena. A flash alone leaves the unit in core-only mode (no modules, no menu; store and USB upload still answer) until Workbench or the CLI installs the package; the browser flow ends at the flash. - [doc] Note records are 0x6c bytes (inserted by `0x4013a98c`, or `0x4013aa66` for a note due now); the frame's note loop loads each at `0x4002dff4`, with the track at +0x10 (16 = none). Held-note source and pitch per track are at `0x47db4310` and `0x47db4560`. `[doc]` {modwerk-1127} — `digitakt-2#d5cc2e7b` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:372](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L372) · Digitakt II / Modwerk added machines, linked voices, filter sites (OS 1.17, 2026-11-14/25)
- [doc] Filter type on the DSP: `DM(0x255990 + track)`, table base loaded at `0x1c26df`; raw types 6-8 map to 0 (no filter) and 9-10 to 1 and 2; at `0x1c6c13` a field of 7 or more jumps past every filter. Kit load keeps a stored filter type only for 0-5 or `0xff` (`0x400db48e`-`0x400db4a5`). `[doc]` Agrees with digikit's earlier reading. {modwerk-1127} — `digitakt-2#9daaeb75` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:373](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L373) · Digitakt II / Modwerk added machines, linked voices, filter sites (OS 1.17, 2026-11-14/25)
- [doc] USB MIDI transmit chain: the chunk sender `0x40121d2a` sends at most 144 bytes per chunk through `0x40121adc`, which takes the mutex (`0x40004668`/`0x40004678`); the serializer `0x40004734` then waits with no bound (`0x40004774`/`0x400047a2`). The waiting allocator is `0x400057b8`; the try allocator `0x40005764` still spins on an active bit at `0x40005792`; submit `0x40005a86` has a 1,000-attempt loop. So a host that does not read can stall the UI inside a SysEx send. `[doc]` {modwerk-1128} — `digitakt-2#a22029c7` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:378](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L378) · Digitakt II / Modwerk's USB link preflight and digikit's LFO table (OS 1.17, static reading, 2026-11-26/28)
- [doc] USB descriptor pool and state: 32 descriptors of 64 B at `0x80000200-0x80000a00`, free head `0x40965b1c`, stock ring at uncached `0x4fe3c000`; MIDI mutex `0x47db406c` (try-acquire `0x40001680`); USB parser state `0x44d2e8c0`, transmitter SysEx state `0x409659c8`. USB interrupt `0x40006e9a`; cancel `0x40005878` calls the callback before it releases the descriptor; drain `0x400059aa`; the bus reset `0x40006dba` rebuilds the pools via `0x40005826` at `0x40006e4c` and walks no completion callbacks. EP 5 (USB MIDI IN): queue head `0x800000c0`, software head/tail `0x800000f0`/`0x800000f4`, mask `0x00020000`. ACR0 is set to `0x4007e020` at `0x4000055e`. `[doc]` {modwerk-1128} — `digitakt-2#0d22105c` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:379](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L379) · Digitakt II / Modwerk's USB link preflight and digikit's LFO table (OS 1.17, static reading, 2026-11-26/28)

- [doc] LFO wave tables (also Digitone II 1.12): the LFO tick (vector 191) and the engine task clamp the wave byte to 0-6 and index four 7-entry tables: the wave functions and three edge-value tables used by modes 3 and 4. digikit's core/lfo-table copies all four with more cells and repoints eight `lea` operands per device; the clamp compare becomes 6+N while its store stays 6, so a byte above 6+N still plays RAND, and an added wave with the stock sine entry and edge value 0 plays sine. `[doc]` {digikit-1128} — `digitakt-2#0b7bcb75` [hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md:381](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/devices/digitakt-2.md#L381) · Digitakt II / Modwerk's USB link preflight and digikit's LFO table (OS 1.17, static reading, 2026-11-26/28)

- [untagged] The whole container is staged in RAM; flash is untouched until the last message. A transfer cut before the footer leaves the screen on "Receiving" and nothing validated, erased or written. - [untagged] No "UPGRADE OS NOW?" on the menu route in the emulator: the delegate returns "do not ask", so after the last message the screen goes ERASING FLASH... -> SUCCESS! NO while receiving asks "CANCEL OS UPGRADE?". — `os-update-protocol#b87e81c0` [hardware/common/os-update-protocol.md:36](https://github.com/70b185/Aggregat/blob/master/hardware/common/os-update-protocol.md#L36) · How Digitakt II and Digitone II take an OS update from the running OS (DT2 1.17, DN2 1.12) / Validation (before any erase; run up to three times)
- [untagged] The flash writer ignores erase/program return codes - "Success" is shown whatever the chips did.
